title: Deep Research on Cloudflare Python Workflows with Gemini
summary: Collier King builds a durable deep research pipeline on Cloudflare Workflows with the Gemini API.
learn: The Gemini Deep Research API uses a file store it chunks and embeds for you, and it runs for minutes, so you have to poll for the result.
Quirks he hit: it is in beta, there is no structured output, and it searched the web even when told not to, so he locked down the prompt.
Cloudflare Python Workflows run on Python Workers and Pyodide; steps can depend on each other or run at the same time, like AWS Step Functions.
His pipeline fetches press releases and transcripts from MongoDB, uploads them, starts the job, waits, extracts JSON and saves to S3-compatible storage and Postgres through Hyperdrive.
The dashboard shows each job run with step logs; runs took from about 5 to 21 minutes.
